summary: This Form 6-K filed by WF Holding Ltd updates its Nasdaq compliance status. On October 28, 2025, the company received a deficiency notice for failing the $1.00 closing bid price rule. After a 180-day cure period ending April 27, 2026, and a 1-for-5 reverse share split implemented April 13, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed on April 28, 2026 that WF Holding regained compliance. The filing is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation event.
